title: Registered-session SendUnitData with connected item pairing and cleanup
purpose: Add a distinct connected-data parser path using the documented Connected Address Item plus Connected Data Item combination, followed by UnregisterSession cleanup.

messages.label: SendUnitData with connected address and connected data items

expected_behavior: Server should process RegisterSession, then parse SendUnitData through the connected CPF pairing. In the absence of a real established connection, a normal invalid-connection or related protocol error is acceptable. UnregisterSession should then cleanly terminate the session.
constraints_preserved: RegisterSession and UnregisterSession use commands 0x0065 and 0x0066
SendUnitData command 0x0070 uses documented Connected Address Item 0x0100 and Connected Data Item 0x00B1 pairing
CPF item count and item lengths are internally consistent
Connected path is structurally distinct from SendRRData unconnected paths
Session handle field is a placeholder for negotiated runtime substitution
issue_safety_notes: This sequence targets connected CPF handling only as a safe structural analogue. It does not claim a real ForwardOpen-created connection and therefore expects ordinary protocol rejection rather than successful data transfer.
